photos.alt: Aerial view of a white multi-unit building with a gravel parking area nestled against a wooded hillside.
Open white kitchen cabinet with stacked white bowls, plates, and mugs on light wood shelves.
Ground-level wooden patio with a black bistro table and two chairs beside a horizontal slat privacy fence.
Small round marble dining table with two black lattice chairs between white louvered closets overlooking the living area.
Wooden Trillium Hill Farm roadside sign with a white church steeple and green-roofed house beyond.
Light gray two-story building showing the white front door marked 3 with yellow daffodils and a gravel parking area.
Bright bedroom with a queen bed in white linens, a mustard throw, matching bedside lamps, and a patterned rug.
Close view of the white Unit 3 front door with a black numeral, lantern light, and yellow daffodils in the garden bed.
High aerial view of the white rental building and gravel lot beside a paved road and wooded hillside.
Full bathroom with a tub shower behind sliding glass doors, white vanity, toilet, and a window with blinds.
Close-up of a made bed with white linens, dark gray velvet pillows, a floral accent pillow, and a lit bedside lamp.
Walk-in closet with white wire shelving, black hangers, and two folding luggage racks on gray carpet.
Panoramic view of snow-dusted mountains and evergreen forests under a clear blue sky.
Living room with a light gray sectional, botanical wall art, and glass doors opening to a private wooden deck.
Exterior entrance to Unit 3 with a white door, black lantern, and a timber-edged bed of yellow daffodils.
Black Ninja coffee maker on a marble countertop against a white subway tile backsplash.
Frost Beer Works exterior with red Adirondack chairs, string lights, and an Order Beer Here window sign.
Aerial view of the white multi-unit Hideaway building tucked between a gravel drive and a steep wooded hill.
Aerial view of the white multi-unit building and gravel drive against a wooded hillside.
Lantman's Market freestanding sign reading Locally Owned Quality Since 1925 with a fruit basket illustration.
Aerial view of a Hinesburg village intersection with a white church steeple, homes, and rolling green hills.
Bedroom corner with a wooden bench, potted tree, mustard throw at the foot of the bed, and an open walk-in closet.
Hinesburg Public House restaurant with olive corrugated siding, a dark awning, and a wooden accessibility ramp.
Bright kitchen with white cabinets and appliances beside a small round marble dining table with black chairs.
Private wooden deck with a square bistro set and lighted privacy fence beside a steep wooded hillside.
Wide aerial of the white Hideaway building at the base of a wooded hill beside a rural highway and distant mountains.
Front facade of the light gray building with Unit 3's white door, dark-trimmed windows, and gravel parking in front.
Aerial view of Hinesburg with a red barn, winding road, clustered homes, and mountains on the horizon.
Kitchen with white cabinets and subway tile beside a dining nook with a round table, black chairs, and botanical prints.
Round marble dining table with two black chairs and a bowl of pears beside a half wall overlooking the living room.
Living room with a light gray L-shaped sectional, concrete-style coffee table, and six botanical prints above the sofa.
Bedroom with a mustard throw on the bed, Roman shades, a wooden bench, and a potted tree between two windows.
White arched Good Times Cafe sign with a sunflower logo and wooden picnic tables on the lawn.
Looking down a narrow gray carpeted staircase with light walls, a wooden handrail, and a small round mirror.
Timber A-frame sign for Shelburne Sugarworks and Four Season Outdoor Center beside rustic wooden buildings.
Bathroom vanity with an oval sink and triple glass light next to a closet with white wire shelving.
Closer aerial of the white townhome row with gravel parking at the base of a forested hill.
Parkside Cafe on the corner of Farmall Drive with sage siding, turquoise Adirondack chairs, and a Coffee flag.
Monument sign for The Cheese Plant listing Public House, Vermont Smoke and Cure, Foam Brewers, and Senix.
Living room with a light gray sectional, concrete coffee table, wall-mounted TV, and a floating wood media shelf.
Interior entry with a white front door, round black-framed mirror, and gray carpeted stairs with a wood handrail.
